main.description: Warm-layer persistence record for organism observations (ADR-2605266400). Flush hook pushes chunks into this AT Protocol collection.

observationCid.description: CID of the underlying raw observation payload (IPFS chunk or AT blob)

actorDid.description: DID of the actor that made or sourced the observation

kind.description: Discriminator for the observation type (aligns with F R1 Tagged Union)

internal_only.description: True if tier=C or restricted. If true, external syncing must drop.

observedAt.description: Original creation time of the observation

flushedAt.description: Time when the observation was flushed from hot buffer to warm storage

provenanceHash.description: L4 adversarial hash-chain link to previous flush (ADR-2605266700)
